pharmacology.text: CP 55,244 is a chemical compound which is a cannabinoid receptor agonist. It is an extremely potent CB1 full agonist with a Ki of 0.21 nM, making it more potent than the commonly used full agonist HU-210.

uses.text: It has analgesic effects and is used in scientific research. It is an extremely potent CB1 full agonist with a Ki of 0.21 nM, making it more potent than the commonly used full agonist HU-210.

summaryZh: CP 55,244是一種有機化合物，分子式C26H42O3，屬於人工合成的大麻素，具有鎮痛藥功能，由輝瑞公司開發，其對CB1的激動劑效果比HU-210更強。
summaryZhHans: CP 55,244是一种有机化合物，分子式C26H42O3，属于人工合成的大麻素，具有镇痛药功能，由辉瑞公司开发，其对CB1的激动剂效果比HU-210更强。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it from controlled studies in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, anxiety, paranoia, vomiting, psychosis, seizures and kidney injury, and their effects are often stronger and less predictable than cannabis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前缺乏人體對照研究的資料。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳過快、焦慮、妄想、嘔吐、精神病症狀、癲癇發作與腎臟損傷，作用往往比大麻更強、更難預測。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前缺乏人体对照研究的数据。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳过快、焦虑、妄想、呕吐、精神病症状、癫痫发作与肾脏损伤，作用往往比大麻更强、更难预测。

fact.en: It is one of Pfizer's non-classical cannabinoids, which open up the ring system of THC. It binds the CB1 receptor even more tightly than HU-210, itself far stronger than THC.
fact.zh: 它是輝瑞的非典型大麻素之一，這類化合物把 THC 的環系統打開。它與 CB1 受體的結合甚至比 HU-210 更緊密，而 HU-210 本身就比 THC 強得多。
fact.zhHans: 它是辉瑞的非典型大麻素之一，这类化合物把 THC 的环系统打开。它与 CB1 受体的结合甚至比 HU-210 更紧密，而 HU-210 本身就比 THC 强得多。
